text:
ana (Finance): Heads up — batch invoices for Stratify (acct S-102) generated this morning 03:14 UTC but finance noticed two problems: compute/gpu usage line missing for several hosts and a duplicated "promo_credit" line that double-applies a $1,200 credit. Example excerpt from preview PDF attached. @matt can you check billing job 0f9a3c? :eyes:

matt (Billing Eng): looking. pulling logs for job 0f9a3c. I see the aggregation lambda returned an empty array for GPU usage shards 3-5, likely a mapping bug. snippet:
```
INFO job=0f9a3c aggregator: shard=3 result=[]
WARN job=0f9a3c invoice-gen: missing line for metric=gpu_hours account=S-102
```
will dig into the mapper that translates usage to lineitems.

kevin (RevenueOps): is the duplicate credit causing negative total? we need to freeze settlement until fixed.

ana (Finance): yes, total shows -$450. Customer-facing invoice sent? toni?

toni (Account Manager): invoice preview was generated but not emailed yet. good call to hold. I'll message account team to suspend send. :heavy_check_mark:

matt (Billing Eng): root cause found — mapper assumes "gpu" and "gpu_hours" both map to same family but when metricDimension=legacy it drops amount. Also duplicate promo credit appears when two discount events are merged without uniq by credit_id. patch incoming.

matt (Billing Eng): quick fix pushed to staging: added dedupe by credit_id + fallback to sum gpu.quantity. Test run on staging job=0f9a3c-replay shows line restored and credit merged to single entry. snippet:
```
INFO job=0f9a3c-replay invoice: added line {sku: "gpu_hours", amount: 384.00}
INFO job=0f9a3c-replay invoice: deduped promo_credit id=cr_9b2f
```

billing-bot: Automated retry scheduled for invoice batch 2026-05-03T03:14Z -> queued (retry-id r-77c2). Will not auto-send until manual approval.

kevin (RevenueOps): good. please add a short root cause blurb and the reconciliation steps to the ticket. Once I confirm totals, I'll approve send.

ana (Finance): creating ticket FIN-5421 with links to logs and staging replay. tagging @matt @toni. ETA for production patch?

matt (Billing Eng): patch ready, will deploy to prod after a quick smoke test (15m). I'll comment in FIN-5421 when done.

toni (Account Manager): I'll prepare customer note template: apology + corrected invoice will be issued, any overapplied credit reversed. draft in FIN-5421.

ana (Finance): thanks all. keeping settlement on hold until kevin signs off. :lock:

kevin (RevenueOps): marking as blocked->dev-fixed. will review after prod smoke. :thumbsup:
